findings.current: تخمینہ شدہ لاگت $0؛ حتمی چارج کی تصدیق نہیں ہوئی۔
findings.problem: src/i18n/bidi.ts isolates a sigil only when it opens a Latin word, so `$` + digit is not isolated. Measured with GNU FriBidi 1.0.16: the `$` resolves to the paragraph (RTL) level 1 while `0` sits at level 2, so the pair is drawn `0$`; reading the RTL line still yields `$0`, which is why the value reads correctly. UAX#9 W5 (ET adjacent to EN joins the number run) says a conformant engine - Chromium/ICU, i.e. the Electron surface - should draw `$0`. The two authorities disagree and the Electron surface was NOT exercised in this pass, so the painted result is unproven.
findings.suggestion: No copy change. Do not reorder the value or insert an LRM (the ur style guide forbids manual bidi controls and storage must stay logical). If a rendered capture shows `0$`, the fix belongs in isolateSigils (accept a digit after the sigil) with a regression test, i.e. a renderer ticket.
findings.disposition: recorded as information for rendered fit; does not gate this catalogue and does not affect the verdict

considered_not_raised: loading.remote: 41 cells vs 31 for English, the longest of the four labels, in a truncating pill. No maxCells declared, the pill sits in the wide transcript column, and shortening ہم آہنگی would break the corpus's sync vocabulary.
loading.older: six words against the sidecar's 'three or four'; word-count hints do not transfer to a postpositional verb phrase. 29 cells in a full-width button.
sound.cost.no_charge: three words against 'one or two'; کوئی چارج نہیں is the smallest natural statement of a confirmed zero and must not read like the unknown state.
summary renders 'cancelled/stopped' as the single word منسوخ: English needs two words because English has two UI words for one outcome; Urdu has one, and it is the same word item_status uses.
latest_update uses از for 'of': five shipped values already use از for the same X-of-Y construction (lightbox, viewer, ownerAudit, projects, hub.teams).
sound_label آواز vs آڈیو elsewhere: mirrors the English sound/audio split rather than contradicting it.
estimated_zero تخمینہ شدہ follows the corpus's productive شدہ/کردہ forms (تیار کردہ, منسوخ شدہ), not a calque of 'estimated'.
The four cost strings are kept as four distinguishable statements (unknown / total unknown / no charge / estimated zero), which is the accuracy risk the sidecar warns about.
Prior round-2 audit of the same 10 keys (session 33f0800c30f3) reached the same conclusions on منسوخ, مجموعی لاگت, از, کوئی چارج نہیں and آواز/آڈیو; re-derived here before reading it, and agreed.
